COMMAND.name: interface
COMMAND.ACTION: if test "${po-if-name}" != ""; then if [ -n "${PoMode}" ]; then key=$(redis-cli -n 4 KEYS "PORTCHANNEL|${po-if-name}"); if [ -n "$key" ]; then echo "%Error: Cannot configure Mode for an existing PortChannel: ${po-if-name}"; exit 1; fi; if [ "${PoMode}" = "on" ]; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORTCHANNEL|${po-if-name}" "static" "true" "admin_status" "up" > /dev/null 2>&1; else redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORTCHANNEL|${po-if-name}" "admin_status" "up" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi; fi; if [ -n "${min-links-value}" ]; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORTCHANNEL|${po-if-name}" "min_links" "${min-links-value}" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi; if [ -n "${fallback}" ]; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORTCHANNEL|${po-if-name}" "fallback" "true" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi; if [ -n "${fast_rate}" ]; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORTCHANNEL|${po-if-name}" "fast_rate" "true" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi; redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORTCHANNEL|${po-if-name}" "admin_status" "up" > /dev/null 2>&1; redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORTCHANNEL_INTERFACE|${po-if-name}" "NULL" "NULL" > /dev/null 2>&1; elif test "${vlan-if-name}" != ""; then vlan_exists=$(redis-cli -n 4 EXISTS "VLAN|${vlan-if-name}"); if [ "$vlan_exists" = "0" ]; then echo "Error: VLAN does not exist. Create VLAN first using 'vlan <id>' command."; exit 1; fi; redis-cli -n 4 HSET "VLAN_INTERFACE|${vlan-if-name}" "NULL" "NULL" > /dev/null 2>&1; elif test "${phy-sub-if-name}" != ""; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE|${phy-sub-if-name}" "parent" "${subifparent}" "admin_status" "down" > /dev/null 2>&1; elif test "${po-sub-if-name}" != ""; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE|${po-sub-if-name}" "parent" "PortChannel" "admin_status" "up" > /dev/null 2>&1; elif test "${lo-if-name}" != ""; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "LOOPBACK|${lo-if-name}" "admin_status" "up" > /dev/null 2>&1; redis-cli -n 4 HSET "LOOPBACK_INTERFACE|${lo-if-name}" "admin_status" "up" > /dev/null 2>&1; elif test "${mgmt-if-name}" != ""; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "MGMT_PORT|eth0" "admin_status" "up" > /dev/null 2>&1; else python3 $SONIC_CLI_ROOT/sonic_cli_utils.py sonic_call_redis_db patch \; ${if-switch} ${vlan-if-name} ${lo-if-name} ${mgmt-if-name} \; ${po-if-name} ${po-sub-if-name} ${phy-if-name} ${phy-sub-if-name} \; mode=${PoMode} min-links=${min-links-value} fallback=${fallback} fast_rate=${fast_rate}; fi;

PARAM.help: Admin advertised speeds of the interface (comma-separated, e.g. 10000,25000,100000)

COMMAND.ACTION: if test -n "${admin_advertise}"; then supported_speeds=$(redis-cli -n 6 HGET "PORT_TABLE|${iface}" "supported_speeds" 2>/dev/null); if test -n "$supported_speeds"; then adv_list=$(echo "${admin_advertise}" | tr ',' ' '); sup_list=$(echo "$supported_speeds" | tr ',' ' '); for adv_spd in $adv_list; do valid=0; for sup_spd in $sup_list; do if test "$adv_spd" = "$sup_spd"; then valid=1; break; fi; done; if test "$valid" = "0"; then echo "%Error: Speed $adv_spd is not supported on ${iface}"; echo "Valid speeds: $supported_speeds"; exit 1; fi; done; fi; fi; redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORT|${iface}" "autoneg" "on" > /dev/null 2>&1; if test -n "${admin_advertise}"; then redis-cli -n 4 HSET "PORT|${iface}" "adv_speeds" "${admin_advertise}" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
